mapper.sql: p.product_id AS productId, ps.style_id AS styleId, ps.style_name AS styleName, ps.style_type AS styleType, ps.style_image AS styleImage, ps.pc_image AS pcImage, psi.add_time AS itemAddTime
mapper.select:
SELECT productId, styleId, styleName, styleType, styleImage, pcImage, itemAddTime FROM ( SELECT
FROM product_style ps INNER JOIN product_style_item psi ON ps.style_id = psi.style_id AND psi.item_type = 1 INNER JOIN product p ON psi.ref_id = p.product_id WHERE 1 = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT
FROM product_style ps INNER JOIN product_style_item psi ON ps.style_id = psi.style_id AND psi.item_type = 2 INNER JOIN product_group pg ON pg.product_group_id = psi.ref_id INNER JOIN product p ON JSON_CONTAINS(pg.product_ids, CAST(p.product_id AS JSON)) WHERE 1 = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT
FROM product_style ps INNER JOIN product_style_item psi ON ps.style_id = psi.style_id AND psi.item_type = 3 INNER JOIN product p ON psi.ref_id = p.brand_id WHERE 1 = 1
) AS combined ORDER BY itemAddTime DESC

SELECT b.brand_id AS brandId, b.brand_name AS brandName, COUNT(p.product_id) AS productCount FROM brand b LEFT JOIN product p ON b.brand_id = p.brand_id AND p.is_delete = 0 AND p.product_status = 1 WHERE b.is_show = 1
AND b.brand_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
GROUP BY b.brand_id, b.brand_name ORDER BY productCount DESC, b.sort_order ASC
